title: EM9305 IRQ remaining 15 whole-handler proofs, typo-RAM literals, and batched p-irqtypo paired sims
reason: Confirm whole-handler typo-vs-stock / as-built-vs-stock executes the real _body; prove the other 15 handlers whole with one frame mutant each; typo-install per handler once proved; one private pbuild and paired sims for all typo installs together.

body_not_stubbed.result: The typo-vs-stock and as-built-vs-stock whole-handler paths execute the real _body. qm.py stubs same-TU callees that are in both orig and cand; TARGET itself is stripped from stubs.o. For typo-vs-stock, _body is only in cand, so it is not stubbed. Typo-vs-typo is the vacuous path (body in both, stub not stripped). No RcCalib rerun was required.

trace.method: QEMU -d in_asm, typo cand ELF build/em-ctl/w/rccalib_typo_whole/cand.trace.elf, T0=1 NTESTS=1
trace.observed: handler 0xc00b0c bl 108 ; 0xc00bd8 to real opencfw_em9305_IRQHandler_RcCalib_body (not stub_hit at 0xc00418). Body executed st 1,[0xf00964,0], mov_s r2,0x801994, st_s r0,[r2,0x24] (0x8019b8), st_s r1,[r2,0x28] (0x8019bc), then restored and j [blink]. stubs.c has no _body; st_*.o has the handler stub stripped. Linked cand nm: handler 00c00b0c W, body 00c00bd8 W, stub_hit 00c00418 T.

qemu_whole_15.harness: build/em-ctl/qm.py --hdir /w/build/em-ctl/h, irq=1, n=100, nor0=0, frame mutant drops r0 restore (88-frame: drop ld.ab r0,[sp,88] / unwind add sp,sp,88; E-frame: pop_s r0 -> add sp,sp,4)

qemu_whole_15.result: All 15 EQUIVALENT 100; all 15 frame mutants KILLED (ret+reghash; typically 99/100, GPIO 100/100).
